alignments.reason: Covers generating whole-unit length measurements and constructing their whole-number line plot, including repeated measurements of one object. Fractional acquisition and arithmetic are separate mathematical actions.

label: 2.MD.D.9
meaning: Practice covers aligned canonical concepts, with no claim of complete standard coverage or mastery.

sourceNode.description: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths of several objects to the nearest whole unit, or by making repeated measurements of the same object. Show the measurements by making a line plot , where the horizontal scale is marked off in whole-number units.
